rules.same_take: waveform test (catalog rules.supplementary_pairing), adopted for set 3 as a stated departure from the envelope test

development_only_bands.Eat The Feeder: its 'Today's The Day' is a set-2 development session

rules.band_stratum: most common session-level gain class over the band's tones; ties to the cleaner class
rules.held_out_draw: rng = random.Random(20261007); for each stratum in ['clean', 'crunch', 'high-gain']: sorted(rng.sample(sorted(eligible bands), 2))
rules.fold_draw: then dev = sorted(development bands not pinned); rng.shuffle(dev); order = [unpinned folds ascending] + [pinned folds]; fold = order[index % 4]; pinned bands keep their K3 fold
rules.lag_sign: positive when the amp track is later than the DI
